sections.text:
According to legend, Cú Chulainn was name after a dog. He fought his last battle where the Newgrange Passage Tomb now stands. [Home Turf]

Scarlet Byrne theorized that Cú Chulainn had to defeat a water Titan or clear a water trap in order to find his Gybolg's Amulet. His Amulet was eventually left in the Newgrange Passage Tomb in Ireland. [Home Turf]

Years later, Scarlet, with the help of Dante´s team, managed to locate and bond with his Titan. Gybolg was then invoked to fight alongside Dante's team aginst Klaus' Suits and defeat one of their Bonelasher Titans. [Home Turf]

History

According to legend, Cú Chulainn was name after a dog. He fought his last battle where the Newgrange Passage Tomb now stands. [Home Turf]

Scarlet Byrne theorized that Cú Chulainn had to defeat a water Titan or clear a water trap in order to find his Gybolg's Amulet. His Amulet was eventually left in the Newgrange Passage Tomb in Ireland. [Home Turf]

Years later, Scarlet, with the help of Dante´s team, managed to locate and bond with his Titan. Gybolg was then invoked to fight alongside Dante's team aginst Klaus' Suits and defeat one of their Bonelasher Titans. [Home Turf]

== History ==
According to legend, Cú Chulainn was name after a dog. He fought his last battle where the [[Newgrange Passage Tomb]] now stands. {{source|Home Turf}}

[[Scarlet Byrne]] theorized that Cú Chulainn had to defeat a water Titan or clear a water trap in order to find his Gybolg's [[Amulet]]. His Amulet was eventually left in the [[Newgrange Passage Tomb]] in Ireland. {{source|Home Turf}}

Years later, Scarlet, with the help of Dante´s team, managed to locate and bond with his Titan. Gybolg was then invoked to fight alongside Dante's team aginst [[Klaus|Klaus']] [[Suits]] and defeat one of their [[Bonelasher]] Titans. {{Source|Home Turf}}

Cú Chulainn was renowned for being a powerful Seeker and became known as the great dog warrior.
